project.name: DermaScope
project.context: Focused facial skin condition analysis from one uploaded face photo.
project.domain: Browser-based facial skin analysis and overlay visualization
project.runtimeConstraint: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + DaisyUI frontend, FastAPI backend for OpenCV-Python analysis.
project.architectureConstraint: Client-side SPA with API-backed image upload analysis and no persistent image storage.

assumptions: Frontend uses /api endpoints for face-photo analysis.
UI must avoid grid or glow wallpaper and keep condition overlays tied to analysis meaning.
Design contract follows the dermatology contact sheet anchor.
The app is an educational image-processing tool, not a medical diagnosis tool.
The input flow supports file upload and browser camera capture.
motionPaletteDecision: Motion: acetate overlay laydown after analysis with reduced-motion immediate swap. Palette: clinical porcelain shell, mint score accents, coral acne/redness marks, amber dark-spot marks, violet wrinkle marks, and teal pore marks.

conceptualAnchor.name: Dermatology contact sheet
conceptualAnchor.anchorReference: clinical dermatology contact sheet with translucent acetate annotations, condition-color marks, and zone strips around one face image
conceptualAnchor.specificReferencePoint: A face photo is treated as the central evidence frame while condition marks and zone strips sit around it like annotated clinical review material.
conceptualAnchor.rationale: The anchor supports a focused human-skin analysis product without falling back to a generic dashboard or medical-device overclaim.
conceptualAnchor.signatureMotion: A translucent analysis overlay settles onto the face after processing.
conceptualAnchor.signatureMove: Condition colors, marker shapes, and short image labels map directly to acne, dark spots, wrinkles, redness, and pores.
conceptualAnchor.typographicDecision: Compact score titles, plain Indonesian body copy, small condition labels, and monospaced counts and percentages.

visualResetStrategy: Reset the prior general image workbench into a single-purpose face analysis surface with one upload, one analysis action, overlay evidence, score stack, and zone breakdown.

derivedTokenLogic.anchorReference: clinical dermatology contact sheet with translucent acetate annotations, condition-color marks, and zone strips around one face image
derivedTokenLogic.colorDerivationSource: Clinical paper surface, skin-safe neutrals, mint score emphasis, coral/amber/violet/rose/teal condition marks.
derivedTokenLogic.spacingDerivationSource: Contact sheet margins around one central image with compact score and zone strips.
derivedTokenLogic.typographyDerivationSource: Clinical review labels: compact titles, plain body text, monospaced numbers.
derivedTokenLogic.motionDerivationSource: Acetate overlay laydown, camera preview readiness, decisive status shifts, and short fades for state changes.
derivedTokenLogic.validationRule: Every token must trace to facial skin analysis; no grid, glow, or generic dashboard tokens are allowed.

functionalRoles: mint indicates the overall skin health score and primary action
coral indicates acne and inflamed spot marks
violet indicates wrinkle and line-density marks
colorTruth.nonTransferableBehavior: The same color family is reused in overlay marks, category scores, and zone rows, which only works because this product maps visible skin-condition signals to face regions.

crossViewportAdaptation.mobile: Upload or analyzed face first, source switch and camera/upload surfaces become one column, action buttons become full-width touch targets, overall score follows the image, and zone rows stack.
crossViewportAdaptation.tablet: Stage remains primary, score/category panels regroup into a two-column stack below the image when sidebar space is tight, and zones regroup below the image.
crossViewportAdaptation.desktop: Stage dominates center-left, condition scores stay right, zone breakdown stays visible below the stage.

motionSystem.reducedMotionFallback: Immediate overlay swap or short fade.

componentMorphology.stage: Central face image stage with original photo and overlay result.
componentMorphology.sourceSwitch: Upload file and camera capture modes before analysis.
componentMorphology.scoreStack: Overall score plus five condition meters.
componentMorphology.statusPill: Service indicator with backend readiness label.
componentMorphology.dropzone: Clinical intake pad with clear face-photo copy.
componentMorphology.zoneStrips: Forehead, cheeks, nose, and chin rows with compact measurements.

aiSafeUiAudit.failureDefinition: Fails if grid, line, or glow wallpaper appears, or if condition colors appear without analysis meaning.
aiSafeUiAudit.backgroundPatternRule: No decorative grid, scanlines, or radial glow backgrounds.

productionContentPolicy.rule: Skin analysis copy must describe visible image-processing signals and avoid diagnosis, treatment, homework, demo, MVP, placeholder, or scaffold language.

accessibilityPolicy.focusVisibility: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements.
accessibilityPolicy.keyboardAccess: Upload, analyze, reset, and dismiss actions must be keyboard operable.

requiredSignals: face overlay result with distinct condition markers

implementationOrder: Finalize score stack, status pill, and zone breakdown
designExecutionHandoff.notes: Keep backgrounds clean, avoid decorative lines or glows, and keep medical disclaimer concise.

mustPass: Overall and category scores are visible
Focus and contrast meet WCAG 2.2 AA
driftSignals: Score stack looks like a generic analytics dashboard
Overlay colors or marker shapes do not match category labels
Medical diagnosis language appears in the UI

allowedSources: official React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, DaisyUI docs

libraryDecisions.purpose: Component model for the frontend UI.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Use the existing static HTML build if React tooling fails.

libraryDecisions.purpose: Frontend dev server and build tool.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Use the static server for local-only preview.

libraryDecisions.purpose: Utility styling and token mapping via DaisyUI.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Use scoped CSS for critical layout if Tailwind config fails.

libraryDecisions.purpose: Semantic component styling and theme tokens.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Swap to base Tailwind utility styling.

repoEvidence.designEvidenceSummary: Frontend exists under frontend/ with React + Vite + Tailwind + DaisyUI. Current scope is now a focused facial skin analysis flow with backend /api processing, overlay output, condition scores, and zone breakdown.
